issue.title: Restore editing headroom in bob-plugins bob-navigation-hotkeys.md after tree link-walk docs (5991/6000 words)
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Proposed by bob-cli-ra.6 (note #1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-ra land agent.

`docs/bob-navigation-hotkeys.md` in bob-plugins (mounted as bob-cli `docs/reference/plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys.md`) is at **5991 / 6000** reference words (`bob_docs.markdown.count_words`, measured by the bob-cli-ra land agent on bob-plugins master a6f7691e). The bob-cli-ra.6 docs phase pushed it there by documenting the `n`-family tree walk (rings, lanes, parent tour, matcher, notices). Any further edit to this page, even a one-line keymap note, will fail `npm run docs:check` / bob-cli `just docs-check`. Agents on unrelated features will then have to trim mid-flight, as happened with bob-cli-jz and bob-cli-ob.

Restore editing headroom to at least 300 words (the `docs_headroom` target used by bob-cli-il, bob-cli-jz, and bob-cli-ob) without losing content. Prefer moving a self-contained family, such as the `n` link walk or Section Map details, onto its own reference page linked from the hotkeys page over cutting prose. Keep every heading anchor that other pages link to, or update the links. Then run `npm run docs:gen`, `npm run docs:check` (which runs bob-cli docs-check), and `bob plugins sync`.

The epic's docs gate passed at 5991, so this is maintenance headroom, not a broken gate. It does not belong to the link-walk epic's scope, which was to document the feature under the cap.

task_type_fields.proposal: Restore at least 300 words of headroom in bob-plugins docs/bob-navigation-hotkeys.md (now 5991/6000), preferably by moving a self-contained family onto its own linked reference page, without losing content or anchors.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The link-walk epic's docs gate passed under the cap. Restructuring the whole hotkeys reference page is general docs maintenance that spans families the epic does not own (Section Map, snooze, task card).

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-ra.6 left bob-navigation-hotkeys.md 9 words under the 6000-word reference cap, so the next unrelated nav-hotkeys docs edit will fail docs-check. Earlier refills of this page (bob-cli-jz, bob-cli-ob) each needed their own headroom task.
